title: Halloween Candy Dispensing Counter
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=candy:counter
| bin _time span=15m
| stats sum(pieces) as candy, dc(visitor) as trick_or_treaters by _time
| sort _time
description: Counts trick-or-treaters and candy handed out through the evening, capturing the Halloween rush hour.
value: A candy-per-quarter-hour chart is pure fun and genuinely helps you buy the right amount next year.
implementation: Log dispenses (a button or sensor) into `index=personal`; chart candy and visitors over the evening.
visualization: Time chart of candy given out and visitors on Halloween.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the trick-or-treaters and sweets you hand out, capturing the busy Halloween rush.
